product_one_liner.value: Aikido is a developer-first security platform that finds, prioritizes and automatically fixes vulnerabilities across code, cloud and runtime for software development and security teams.

hq_location.notes: The company labels San Francisco its US HQ and Ghent, Belgium its European HQ; the company profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying engineering posts: May 12, 2026, by OCaml engineer and Opengrep maintainer Dimitris Mostrous, on engine architecture, parallelism and taint analysis; September 21, 2026, coauthored by lead engineer Selim Decamps, on model quantization and expert pruning for Aikido Altar.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live AI Engineer opening in Tel Aviv, building production AI agents for vulnerability research, patch generation and validation.

model_provider.value: Aikido Altar, its own open-weight security model derived from GLM-5.3, powers Aikido Machine.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a publicly claimed compliance status, not a certification; it is included because the question explicitly lists it.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 14, 2026 Series B falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Account Executive US opening.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 20, 2026, Aikido launched Noon, a workforce security platform covering email security, device protection, AI governance and phishing simulations/training.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Benji Kalman joined as Senior Vice President of Engineering in June 2026 following the Root.io acquisition; his June 30, 2026 announcement confirms Root became part of Aikido.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting explicitly requires pipeline management and accurate forecasting in HubSpot.
